guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent: The Dockerfile fails to build because the apt package manager cannot locate the packages python3.12, python3.12-venv, and python3.12-distutils on Ubuntu 22.04 (jammy). This likely occurs because Ubuntu 22.04 does not provide Python 3.12 packages by default in its official repositories. To fix this, consider either installing a supported Python version available in Ubuntu 22.04 repos, such as python3.10, or add the appropriate PPA (e.g., deadsnakes PPA) to install Python 3.12 and its related packages. You may add commands to add the PPA repository before installing Python 3.12 packages. Alternatively, use an official Python 3.12 base image instead of Ubuntu 22.04 if strict Python 3.12 is required.
